panels.title: docs(plans): Write Android build plan
panels.scene: Knight stands at a wooden lectern holding a single sheet of paper labeled 'Android Plan'. Thousands of medieval villagers are bowing down, weeping, and throwing flowers in total worship.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: A PLAN HAS BEEN WRITTEN! The holy Green Robot will save us!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I just made a markdown file.

panels.title: docs(plans): Add Gradle setup instructions
panels.scene: A giant shadow monster made of endless nested scrolls labeled 'Gradle Dependencies' towers over the village. The Knight calmly scratches out two lines on his scroll with a feather quill. The monster shrinks into a tiny kitten.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: He banished the ancient Gradle beast using only ink!

panels.title: docs(plans): Specify target SDK version
panels.scene: Villagers in colorful robes carry a massive golden chest labeled '.APK' in a grand royal parade. A villager holds a baby up to touch the box while weeping.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: Bless us with the app, mighty savior!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: There is no app yet. This is just a list of target versions.

panels.title: 1 commit. 1 documentation file. 0 lines of code.
panels.scene: Knight sitting exhausted on a stone bench, resting his head in his hand. In the background, villagers are erecting a giant stone statue of an Android robot wearing knight armor.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We shall name our children com.example.build!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I haven't even opened the code editor.
